Regional Sales Manager – Midwest

Company: Kestrel Industrial Supply

Kestrel Industrial Supply is hiring a Regional Sales Manager to lead our Midwest territory (IL, WI, MN, IA). You will manage a team of 7 account executives and own a $28M annual quota.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and hire account executives; run weekly pipeline reviews in Salesforce
  • Own regional revenue forecasting and quota attainment
  • Build relationships with key accounts and distributors; negotiate annual contracts
  • Partner with marketing on lead generation campaigns

Requirements

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience, including 2+ years managing a sales team
  • Track record of exceeding quota in industrial, manufacturing or distribution sales
  • Proficiency with Salesforce CRM and pipeline management
  • Strong negotiation and presentation skills
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Business or related field
  • Experience selling MRO or safety products

Compensation: base plus commission, company vehicle, 401(k).
